Index.title: Temple of Light
Index.subtitle: A Digital Sanctuary
Index.heroSubtitle: Seek clarity, finding quiet amidst the noise. A sanctuary for peace, wisdom, and connection.
Index.cardHallDesc: Enter the sacred center. Experience a visual meditation and inscribe your digital offerings.
Index.cardChatDesc: Speak with an enlightened AI guide, grounded in sacred Buddhist texts.
Index.cardWishDesc: Inscribe your prayers upon a digital tile, carried upward by collective light.
Index.cardPillarsDesc: Honor supporters whose names are forever etched in luminous stone.
Index.cardDharmaDesc: Immerse yourself in sacred scriptures and timeless Buddhist wisdom.

Dharma.title: Dharma Library
Dharma.subtitle: Find peace in the ocean of wisdom.
Dharma.boriMessage: There's so much wisdom here! Let's explore together! ✨
Dharma.mayWisdomLight: May this wisdom light your path

Guru.title: The Enlightened Guide
Guru.welcome: Welcome, traveler. What thoughts drift across your mind like clouds across the moon today?
Guru.boriMessage: Master is a little serious, isn't he? Feel free to speak your heart!
Guru.aiDisclaimer: This conversation is with an AI agent. It does not replace professional medical, legal, or financial advice.
Guru.ebookWait: The Guru is distilling your conversation into sacred narrative. This may take up to 30 seconds…
Guru.ebookFailed: The Guru could not complete the story at this time. No lotus petals were deducted. Please try again.
Guru.ebookNoMessages: Please have a conversation with the Guru first.
Guru.upgradeBody:
Your lotus petals have blossomed fully for now.
Offer new petals to continue your journey of wisdom.
Guru.fallbackMsg: In stillness, the answer will come. Please try again.
Guru.rateLimitMsg: The temple asks for stillness. Please wait a moment before speaking again.
Guru.unexpectedError: An unexpected response from the Guru. Please try again.

WishRoof.title: The Wish Roof
WishRoof.subtitle: Inscribe your intentions upon the celestial canopy.
WishRoof.boriMessage: I picked the prettiest lantern just for you! Write your wish and I'll hang it on the roof! 🥺
WishRoof.snackbarLike: You have lit this wish with your heart. 🙏
WishRoof.snackbarUnlike: Your light has returned to your heart.

Pillars.title: Hall of Support
Pillars.subtitle: The names of those who sustain this sanctuary are etched in eternal stone.

Donate.title: Make an Offering
Donate.subtitle: Your generosity sustains this space of peace and wisdom for seekers around the world. Every offering is received with deep gratitude and mindfulness.
Donate.realTier1Desc: Light a single flame in the sanctuary. Your light joins the collective glow.
Donate.realTier2Desc: Offer a lotus. Your name joins the Serenity Pillar on the temple wall.
Donate.realTier3Desc: Erect a Pillar of Light with your name engraved permanently in virtual marble.
Donate.lotusTier1Desc: A small offering of presence. Your energy joins the collective field.
Donate.lotusTier2Desc: Ring the virtual bell. Your intention resonates through the temple for all seekers.
Donate.lotusTier3Desc: Illuminate the shrine. Your contribution of light supports the community for one moon cycle.
Donate.comingSoon: 🔔 Virtual offering of {count} lotus petals — coming soon!
Donate.lotusModeNote: 🪷 Your lotus petals were received with gratitude. Offering them back to the temple community is a beautiful act of dana — the Buddhist virtue of generosity.
